title: Verify current main instrumented CI after S45 merge
findings_note: S22: latest published main Build run 37258797096 at fcd5106 has build success and instrumented failure; local 816a80f includes subsequent S45 changes and passes 56 API 36 tests.
boundary: Verify published main CI after the local S45 merge. No workflow changes without an observed failure on the current revision; pushing remains an owner-authorized action.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S22 requires both jobs green on the latest published main run. Run 37258797096 at fcd5106 has build success and instrumented failure, before the local S45 merge at 816a80f. Local API 36 instrumentation passes 56 tests; it does not establish CI success.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: .github/workflows/build.yml and app/src/androidTest only if a current-revision failure requires a change.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Published main run https://github.com/squalor-xyz/consecutor/actions/runs/37258797096: instrumented job failed at Instrumented tests on a managed device; build job succeeded. Root cause has not been established.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. After the owner publishes the current main revision, inspect the latest Build workflow run and both job results.
2. If current-revision instrumented tests still fail, obtain the reports and fix only the observed cause in a slice worktree; check for overlap with completed S61 and S45.
3. Record the revision, run URL, job outcomes and any local reproducer. Do not push or rerun shared CI without owner authorization.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Latest Build workflow run on published main has both build and instrumented jobs completed successfully, with the verified revision and run URL recorded.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when asked; use the project's slice worktree workflow.
